tools.name: present_pdf
tools.description: Upload a PDF to start a local Presio presentation. Returns a url — open it in a browser to finish handoff (skips share). To replace an existing presentation's deck instead of creating one, pass its session_id plus controller_token (the t= parameter of the url from the original create call) and the same link keeps working. Same as POST /api/present.

session_id.description: Id of an existing presentation to update in place (from an earlier present response) instead of creating a new one

controller_token.description: Controller token for that presentation — the t= query parameter of the url returned when it was created. Required whenever session_id is given.

tools.name: check_pdf
tools.description: Validate Presio notes/media sidecar attachments in a PDF. Same as POST /api/check.

tools.name: plugin_guide
tools.description: The guide to building a Presio plugin: the workflow (a presio-<name> GitHub repo from the template, the checker, a tag, and a ?plugins= link that loads it), the manifest, and the full window.presio API. Read it before writing a plugin. Same as GET /plugins.md.
